selection: All v8 final false-feasible train starts and, for each, the nearest actually feasible saved start of the same map by absolute budget difference (tie: lower k). Deduplicate and sort map/k. Never infer monotonicity, use development, or replace labels with predictions.

fit.rule: One fresh deep copy of the fixed v8 final model. Full-batch MSE of unchanged common-stop cost/reach targets on the fixed selected starts, equally weight positive/nonpositive reach strata. Train only the two original critics. Evaluate all local rows after every update; stop at first local numerical-and-sign pass or the 400-step cap. No retry, stage transfer, intermediate selection or automatic expansion. The learning rate matches the original phase-II refit, but the subset/optimizer reset differ from v8; this is a local fitting probe, not a controlled attribution to any single change.

local_acceptance: Report separately both critics' original relative-MAE/Pearson checks, component signs, joint signs and false-feasible/false-infeasible counts. Local pass requires original applicable numerical thresholds and every selected component and joint sign correct. It only demonstrates fitting these known starts. It is not the full v5 train gate, G4, deployment or generalization acceptance.
full_train_review: Directly call the unchanged v5 train_gate on the pilot's original 90+72 train episodes before and after the local probe, report all regressions, never substitute local metrics for this result. No development scoring even if either check passes.
downstream: Save a diagnostic-only probe checkpoint with CPU reload, source/actor hashes and full logs. Never publish a deployment bundle, feed this checkpoint to NAV-066, expand to six models, or automatically train another architecture. Further action needs evidence review and a separately bounded registration.
failure_policy: Proposed settings are not permission for optimizer steps. A new explicit approved, hash-pinned registration is required. Output directories are exclusive. Nonfinite loss/gradient/parameter stops and preserves failure evidence; retain the current diagnostic checkpoint. No additional data, relaxed gates, old quota reuse or overwritten historical artifacts.
